notes.title: Rally: Endless Conquest 1.0 release coming Oct. 3rd!
notes.notes:
The title says it all! The full release will be happening Oct. 3rd. It's a bit later than expected mainly due to marketing reasons, and because of a steam policy I can't do a launch discount until near the start of October, but it's not far off! The marketing outreach did not go exactly as I had hoped, but I still am optimistic that people will try out and enjoy the 1.0 release. In the meantime I've mostly been working on polish and art rework, and there's a new playable character that lets you choose your starting cards. 

That's about all for this update, see you all on the 3rd! 

-Bleem

notes.title: Rally 1.0 release is coming up!
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone,

I have made a lot of progress in developing the game in the last month, and everything is almost ready for launch. The game should be ready to release some time in September, and I will have a specific date depending on how some marketing things go. All the main game mechanics and content are in place, it's mostly a matter of readying the store page and finishing some final art assets. The only potential delay is that I am possibly within a discount lockout period for 30 days (I'd like to launch with a discount), but I am working on getting this resolved.  

I'll send an update once I have a specific date! 
Thank you everyone for your interest and support for the game--until next time. 

Bleem

notes.title: Steam Achievements Update! V.7
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! Before getting into the update, I am sorry for the lack of updates and communication in the last year. I am currently in the final semester of my Master’s degree, and I have not put aside much time to work on the game as of late. Things are currently busy with my thesis work, so I won’t give a timeline for the final release, but I can guarantee that Rally will be finished! The game is getting close to release—the main things I want to accomplish at this point are some art and UI reworks/polish as well as expanding the final card pool a bit more. It is also possible that, depending on the reception of the game at launch, I will do another large content update after V1.0 release.

For this current update, I have added 30+ steam achievements into the game which was a feature a few people had requested. You may notice that there are a few hidden achievements; most of these are related to secret cards that have been in the game (mostly) since launch! To my knowledge, only one of the secret cards has been found so far, so I am interested in seeing if more can be discovered! I will add a few more achievements (and secret cards) for the final release of the game, but I think there is a good selection to get started with.

I was working on a ‘collection’ feature where you can see all of the cards that you have unlocked, but it ended up being quite unoptimized and laggy. I hope to have a better version of that finished soon that I can add in as a minor update. This update also has a few minor balance changes and updates to easy mode.

That’s all for this update, thank you all for your support of the game, and I look forward to seeing what secrets you can uncover!

notes.title: Quick update on the next patch!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
I hope you're all enjoying a good holiday season. Just wanted to drop a quick update here for the upcoming expansion because I haven't posted anything in a while. It's been a busy December in terms of school work, but now that the holiday break is starting soon, I'll have more opportunity to focus on game development. The upcoming update is a bit behind schedule, so I'm anticipating a launch sometime in February. This will be the first major content update for the game which will introduce a new faction! I mentioned a potential smaller update to the faction resource system, but apart from some tweeks, I've decided to focus on that after the major update is out. There haven't been any small updates for the last couple months partly because of a lack of new users/bug reports, but also because I did not plan the builds very well and didn't come up with an architecture that easily allows for small updates while I work on the new content (I'll think about this more for the next major update). 
That's about it for this announcement. Stay tuned for the next update, and happy holidays!

notes.title: Army Update is here!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, let's get right into it with the new features in this patch!

Major features
-New army attack types
-New sabotage cards (and instant sabotages)
-New unlockable player general
-Difficulty settings (and a special card unlock for winning on hard mode!)

Balance updates
-Cursed ground now only has a 75% chance to spawn a ghost
-Gooey puddle gives 4 slimes instead of 3
-Priest has 2,0,1 base stats
-Orb of power gives +3 permanent attack
-Gravestone has 2 defense
-Knight gives +2 attack and defense 
-Trebuchet can target all unit rarities 
-Endless armies now scale with a new attack type

Other updates and fixes
-Modified tutorialization
-Tweaked army UI shake
-Dwarf fortify ability correctly stops sabotage glow effect
-Added in some defensive code to attempt to stop a game breaking bug

Closing remarks
I think the new army changes add a little more variety to combat without overcomplicating the gameplay. I hope that the mechanics can remain simple while allowing for complexity without demanding it. There's always more to be done, and in particular, I plan to update the army art a bit soon. With the army update out of the way, I will focus more on developing the next faction, and the only moderate update I anticipate between now and then will be an improvement on the current faction resource system--there will of course be numerous small updates along the way. I do plan for new existing faction cards and generals, but I haven't decided if I'll release any before the new faction. Thank you as always for the feedback and for playing the game! Until next time

notes.title: Endless mode and name update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Due to difficulty with finding the game on steam and some helpful feedback, I have changed the name of the game to "Rally: Endless Conquest" (art pending). 
To complement the new name, endless mode is now live! See how far you can get against the Infinite Army! For now, this is a very basic endless mode, but in the future I plan to have a unique set of sabotage cards for this mode, and maybe some other special features. 
Thank you everyone for the attention and support of the game, and I hope you can enjoy the update! 

Other changes in this update:
-UI tweaks
-Fixed a redundancy with the "Record" effect on cards
-[HOPEFULLY] fixed a bug where permanent data was being reset! (if anyone still experiences this issue, please leave a comment in the forums)
